📢 Announcement Darius DB (Lite Version 0.1.4) — Unified Full-Stack Web, PHP, Mailpit & Database Stack by Darius Cumpio (MIT)

New in Lite Version 0.1.4: Database CRUD & Import/Export (Create, Show, Edit, Delete, Show All, .sql/.csv/.bak Import & Single/Selected-Table Export), 1-Click GitHub Updater & Auto-Restart, Toggle-Switch Apache 2.4 + PHP 8.x + MariaDB/MySQL (:3306) Stack, Mailpit (:8025), SQL Server 2025 auto-sqlcmd, and 1-Click Self-Repair.

Click "Check & Install New Versions" to discover and install the latest PHP, Mailpit, MariaDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Redis releases.

🔧 Repair Darius DB (Lite Version 0.1.4)

        
      

      

        

          Diagnoses and repairs missing portable folders (www/, bin/, data/,
          etc/, logs/, tmp/), corrupted settings.json or engine
          config files, stale PID locks (e.g. PostgreSQL postmaster.pid), and MS SQL Server LocalDB
          instances — while keeping all your databases in data/ untouched.
